protocol.horizon: fixed placements; no PV extensions; terminal-only stability cuts; direct full-window root
protocol.cutoffPolicy: terminal detection before static evaluation; positive-depth passes preserve placements
protocol.rules: Full-window, all legal alternatives; passes preserve placement depth; estimated Edax discs unless independently solved; raw and awarded-empty margins kept separate
protocol.sampling: One full trajectory per root; equal legacy B1/12% and B4/2% policies in each phase, 12 occupied exclusion boundary; exact roots use seeded random complete trajectories
